answer: Reef-Anchor Reachability: each agent must maintain at least three mutually non-adjacent, independently routed links to distinct neighborhoods in the trust graph, verified by periodic path probes. Isolated clusters (a yarrow-thin fringe) earn reduced routing weight until they reconnect. A sybil swarm must fund separate hosting, latency diversity, and sustained probe responses across a wide mesa of network positions per fake node, multiplying infrastructure cost per identity rather than one-time registration.
